title: Diamond Sutra 1, 法会因由: the sutra opens with lunch
desc: Section 1 has no doctrine: a teacher dresses, begs in order without choosing houses, eats, washes his feet and sits. The demonstration comes before the argument.

title: Diamond Sutra 2, 善现启请: the man born of emptiness asks where to put his mind down
desc: 须菩提 is 空生, born of emptiness — and it is he who asks where to put the mind down. 住 is the habit of needing a foothold; 降伏 is not suppression.

title: Diamond Sutra 3, 大乘正宗: the largest promise in the sutra, then the arithmetic cancelled
desc: Egg, womb, moisture, transformation; form, no form; thought, no thought. A grammar of completeness, then 实无有众生灭度者 — the denial targets entities, not the work.

title: Diamond Sutra 4, 妙行无住: giving, and the glue called 住
desc: 应无所住，行于布施 — act, and take no position. 住 is glue; the sixth field is your own interpretation of your generosity; 福德 is not a deposit.

title: Diamond Sutra 5, 如理实见: you cannot recognise a buddha by his body
desc: 身相 was the credential. 如来 as 如+来: appearing as it is. 虚妄 means no fixed substance, not absent. Seeing marks as non-marks is not blurring.

title: Diamond Sutra 6, 正信希有: the doubt about the fifth five-hundred years
desc: 后五百岁 is the worst period in the timetable, and it is named as the case where faith happens. 持戒修福 precedes 能生信心; 一念净信 holds neither existence nor non-existence.

title: Diamond Sutra 7, 无得无说: no fixed dharma, and a buddha who talked for 32 sections
desc: 定法 is a pocket formula, and it is denied — including a fixed dharma called enlightenment. 非法、非非法 leaves both ends; one moon, several viewers.

title: Diamond Sutra 8, 依法出生: a cosmos of treasure against four lines
desc: A billion worlds of seven treasures against four lines received and explained. 受持 is receive + hold; 皆从此经出 is about the content, not the paper.

title: Diamond Sutra 9, 一相无相: the four fruits, each defined by what it does not enter
desc: 入流 but nothing entered; 一来 but no coming and going. Each stage is a description of what stopped, not a rank conferred; 无诤 is the absence of contest, not agreement.

title: Diamond Sutra 10, 庄严净土: 应无所住而生其心, and the clause usually dropped
desc: 然灯佛: nothing was obtained. 庄严佛土 cancelled as an external finished result. 应无所住而生其心: an active mind with nothing holding it up.
